candidate.definition_en: Happening as a minor accompaniment to something else; not the main part.
candidate.explanation_ar: حاجة بتحصل بالصدفة أو كشيء جانبي مش أساسي مع حاجة تانية.

senses.definition_en: Happening as a minor accompaniment to something else; not the main part.
senses.explanation_ar: عارض أو ثانوي، يحدث كشيء جانبي مرافق لشيء آخر وأقل أهمية منه.
examples: Any resemblance to real persons is purely incidental.
The discovery was incidental to their main research.
Cognitive development is not merely incidental to physical growth.
